    ordered = sorted(values)

    """Return the median of a non-empty list of numbers."""
    ordered = sorted(values)

def median(values):
    """Return the median of a non-empty list of numbers."""
    ordered = sorted(values)
    mid = len(ordered) // 2
    if len(ordered) % 2 == 1:
        return ordered[mid]
    return (ordered[mid] + ordered[mid + 1]) / 2

def median(values):
    """Return the median of a non-empty list of numbers."""
    ordered = sorted(values)
    mid = len(ordered) // 2
    if len(ordered) % 2 == 1:
        return ordered[mid]
    return (ordered[mid] + ordered[mid + 1]) / 2
